tabs.label: Opening Spiel
tabs.title: Phase 1: Opening Spiel
tabs.html:
Pick the opener for the lead type. Both openers include the recorded-line disclosure; keep it. If the customer only wants one cleaning, go to Sales Pitch and open One-Time Only Cleaning.

For APEX leads

Hi (Customer), this is (Your Name) from Homeaglow calling on a recorded line. I noticed you visited one of our websites or have seen one of our ads. I wanted to call to see how we can help schedule a cleaning for you.

For Revisit leads

Hi (Customer), this is (Your Name) from Homeaglow calling on a recorded line. You checked us out a while back, and I can see you recently came back to our site looking into our cleaning services, so I wanted to reach out while it's fresh. I'd love to hear what brought you back and see how we can help.

If they ask to stop calling

Don't re-hook or ask another question. Thank them, end the call, and tag the lead CLOSED - DO NOT CALL AGAIN in HubSpot. See Process Updates · DNC Requests.

tabs.label: Discovery
tabs.title: Phase 2: Sales Discovery
tabs.html:
Use the APEX flow or the Revisit flow depending on the lead. Finish discovery before you pitch.

APEX leads: transition into discovery

S1: (Customer Name), it's important that I make sure we cover all the things that are important for you. I'd like to ask a few questions to make sure that we are the right match for you.

S2: (Customer Name), I want to make sure that we get the best bang for your buck. I'd like to ask a few questions to make sure we check all the boxes for you.

S3: (Customer Name), my goal is to make sure we're a good fit for you. Would you mind answering a few quick questions so I can get a better sense of what you're looking for?

Then work through Levels 1 to 5 in the Discovery Questions tab.

Revisit leads

Q1. Trigger: So, what's going on that brought you back to look at cleaning services? Anything specific come up?

Q2. Past experience: When you first checked us out, do you remember what held you back from booking? I just want to make sure we address that this time around.

Q3. Current situation: Got it. And right now, are you looking for a one-time clean or more of a recurring setup? I want to make sure I point you in the right direction.

Q4. Logistics: Perfect. What area of (City/State) are you in, and how many bedrooms, bathrooms are we looking to get cleaned?

Redirect: if the lead is guarded or says "I'm just looking"

Totally understand, no pressure at all. A lot of people come back just to compare options, and honestly, that's smart. Can I at least walk you through how we work so you have everything you need to make a decision on your own time?

tabs.label: Elevator Pitch
tabs.title: Phase 3: Elevator Pitch
tabs.html:
Homeaglow intro

A little about us, Homeaglow is the largest home cleaning company in the U.S., with over 10 years of experience and 2.6 million cleanings completed for nearly 900,000 customers.

We connect you with 20,000+ trusted, background-checked cleaners including over 100 in your area. Best of all, we offer deeply discounted rates to make quality cleaning more affordable than ever.

tabs.title: Phase 4: Data Gathering
tabs.html:
Confirm the home size so you can pick the right FCF hours in the Sales Pitch.

Checklist

  • How many rooms are we looking to clean?
  • How many bedrooms and bathrooms?
  • How often are you looking to get your home cleaned?

Regular cleaning: staging

S1: Thank you so much for choosing Homeaglow! Just to make sure I understand this better, how do you envision the regular cleaning as part of your routine?

S2: I can understand how tight schedules can get especially if you're working and have kids. Many of our customers choose Homeaglow for the exact same reason.

S3: Thanks for sharing that with me. My (grandma/grandpa/aunt/etc) also struggles with cleaning their own home and it really helped them a lot when they started getting a cleaning professional.

Negotiate

Step 1: Acknowledge the concern.

Step 2.1: Ask the qualifying question

Is the membership not a good fit because of the cost, there is a commitment, or because you just don't feel you need regular cleanings right now?

Step 2.2: Adjust the MF or commitment based on the trigger

  • Membership fee: reduce to $54, then to $49 if necessary.
  • Commitment duration: offer to shorten.
  • Both: offer reducing both.
  • Not about cost or commitment: go to Step 3.

If the customer agrees, go to Booking. If they decline, go to Step 3.

Step 3: Highlight FC value and offer a one-time or trial cleaning

I totally understand that your (move-in/out, event) cleaning is the priority right now, and we're happy to take care of that for you. If the membership isn't the right fit, no worries at all!

You can try our service at a discounted rate of $X for 30 days. You can cancel with no obligation anytime within those 30 days if it's not the right fit. If you don't cancel within 30 days, the membership will automatically continue at $59 per month with a 6-month minimum commitment. If you cancel before completing 6 paid months of membership, a $99 early termination fee applies.

Does this option work better for you?

Next: Booking.

One-Time Only Cleaning

Step 1: Acknowledge and present the one-time option

Got it! We'd be happy to take care of that for you!

For standard one-time cleanings, this would be at our regular price of $X for X hours. If the cleaning goes over 3 hours, I can also apply a special discount to bring it down to $Y.

Does this work for what you need today?

Step 2: Gauge openness to membership

Out of curiosity, if this first cleaning ends up being super helpful, do you see yourself needing this kind of help every so often?

I only ask because a lot of our customers start with a one-time clean but end up finding value in having ongoing support, and our ForeverClean membership could save you up to 60% each time you have a cleaning. It starts as low as $59 a month, and the savings from today alone could already make up for it. Would you like me to walk you through what that could look like?

Step 3: Qualify the objection (if they say no to the membership, explore why)

Totally fair. Just so I can better understand, is it more about the cost, because there's a commitment, or do you just feel like you don't need regular cleanings right now?

Step 4: Negotiate

  • Membership fee (for the $59 cohort): reduce to $54, then to $49 if necessary.
  • Commitment duration: offer to shorten.
  • Both: offer reducing both.
  • Not about cost or commitment: book the one-time clean.

If the customer compares the FC ETF to the one-time rate:

That's why the FC membership offers better value overall. It's designed for ongoing service, but even if your plans change unexpectedly, the early termination fee is a flat rate of $35/hr based on the hours of your first cleaning. It's still lower than the ($X) one-time cleaning rate, so you're getting the best rate either way.

Next: Booking.

tabs.title: Phase 6: Booking
tabs.html:
So, if that checks out with you, let's get you one of the vouchers and set up the cleaning. I just need your card details. Are we going to use a credit or debit card?

May I ask for your ZIP code?

What date would you like us to come and clean?

If the customer has no exact date yet

We can book the appointment as early as (2 days from today), will that work for you?

We can make a standing appointment for you and then change it later on once you have the exact date on when you'd like to have the cleaning.

Same-day or next-day request

Normally we recommend a 2-day window to allow the cleaning professionals to take the appointment. Would (2 days from today) work for you?

If they agree, book it. If they decline, offer tomorrow:

Same-day appointments are a special priority option for customers who have worked with cleaners in the platform before. Cleaners have the option to accept these appointments as repeat bookings. Since this is your first time with us, it may be a little harder to secure a same-day slot, so we always recommend booking at least two days in advance to ensure availability.

I'd be happy to try to find a cleaner for tomorrow if that works for you! While we can't always guarantee availability on short notice, I'll do my best to make it happen. To ensure we can accommodate you, it might be helpful to provide an alternate date that works for you.

Before the card is charged: temporary card hold (read word for word)

One quick thing so nothing surprises you on your statement. Before your first cleaning, we may place a temporary hold of up to $75 on your card to confirm it's valid. It's not a charge. After your cleaning, we only take what's actually owed for that visit, like any extra hours you add, and the rest of the hold is released. Your first cleaning is still free. You may see it as pending on your bank shortly after booking.

When: before charging the card, ideally as you book the first job. Pending final confirmation; your TL will tell you if this changes.

Successful upsell +0.2 QANot offered −0.2 QA

Step 1, make the offer (read word for word):

One last thing before I let you go. Most of our cleaners are great, but in busy areas the very best ones are in high demand, so there's a lot of competition for them. Would you like to be in our Premium Cleaner Program? It makes sure you have access to our top cleaners and puts your cleanings on their radar first. It's $20 per cleaning, and you won't be charged if your cleaner is under 4.5 stars.

Step 2, if the customer agrees, confirm (read word for word):

Just to confirm, I'm adding Premium Cleaner to your account. That's $20 per cleaning, plus applicable taxes, and it only applies to cleanings completed by a Premium Cleaner. If a Premium Cleaner isn't assigned, there's no charge for that appointment. Is that okay with you?

Get a clear YES on the recorded call before you add it. Silence, "I guess" or "sure, whatever" is not a clear yes: ask once more.

If the customer says no: "No problem at all." Don't pressure them; go straight to System Notes. The requirement is to properly offer it.

Quick answers

  • Is the $20 a one-time fee? No. It's $20 per cleaning, plus applicable taxes, only when a Premium Cleaner completes it.
  • Charged if no Premium Cleaner is assigned? No charge for that appointment.
  • Can it apply to the first cleaning? Yes, if a Premium Cleaner completes the first appointment.

If anything is unclear, ask your TL before your next call.

tabs.label: Value Statements
tabs.title: Value Statements
tabs.html:
Use these to re-anchor value mid-call. Match the value to what the customer told you in Discovery.

24/7 Customer Support

S1: Unlike most cleaning companies, we offer 24/7 support across the board, not just for customer service, but for sales and scheduling too. You may have noticed how quickly we called you; that's not typical. Other companies may take hours or days to respond, if they reply at all. With Homeaglow, you also get access to a 24/7 online dashboard, so you can schedule or reschedule your cleanings anytime, without needing to wait on emails or phone calls. And if anything isn't up to your expectations after a cleaning, our round-the-clock Customer Support Team is ready to jump in and make it right.

S2: What really sets Homeaglow apart from other cleaning companies is that we have a dedicated 24/7 Customer Support Team. This means that anytime you need help with your appointments, we're always with you to make sure that everything goes smoothly.

S3: Most of our customers enjoy the benefit of knowing that we have a 24/7 Customer Support Team ready to assist anytime. This means that if something wasn't to your liking after an appointment, you can let us know and we'd be happy to make it right for you.

Price and Cost Efficiency

S1: Our FC Membership is built for value. Members enjoy rates up to 60% lower than traditional cleaning companies, without compromising on quality. Now you might be wondering how we do that. Because we've streamlined operations with an online dashboard, we save on customer service costs, and we pass those savings directly on to you. It's cost-efficient, high-quality cleaning that aligns with your budget perfectly.

S2: Our FC Membership is designed to give our customers heavily-discounted rates on their subsequent cleanings. This means that you get to enjoy quality, cost-efficient cleaning that aligns with your budget.

S3: What our members love about their FC Membership is that they get to enjoy rates that are up to 60% lower than other cleaning companies. This means you get to enjoy better quality cleaning service at a more affordable cost.

Schedule Flexibility

S1: Our customers love their Account Dashboard. This gives you full control and freedom to manage your appointments: change the date, the time, even book as many or as few cleanings as fit into your schedule.

S2: The beauty of your FC Membership is that it comes with your own personal Dashboard. This means that you can manage your appointments in minutes, making it easier and more seamless for you to plan your schedule.

Top-Rated Cleaners

S1: Most of our customers truly value the peace of mind they get knowing every cleaner on the Homeaglow platform is thoroughly vetted, with strict criminal and background checks. But we go beyond safety, we focus on quality too. Just to share with you, 91.4% of jobs are completed by cleaners with a 4.5-star rating or higher. And because we collect ratings and reviews after every appointment, we're able to continually curate the best professionals. Unlike the gray market, where underperforming cleaners can bounce between clients, Homeaglow ensures only top-rated, trustworthy cleaners stay on our platform, so you always get someone who knows how to deliver a great clean.

S2: Most of our customers appreciate that all of the cleaning professionals who get on board the platform are thoroughly vetted and have gone through strict criminal and background checking. This gives you the peace of mind, knowing that the person cleaning your home is someone who is trustworthy, and has the experience to do the job excellently.

Cleaner Availability

One of the biggest advantages of booking through us is the reliability at scale. With over 20,000 cleaning professionals on our platform, you're never left hanging. If your cleaner is unavailable, whether it's last-minute or due to illness, we've got qualified backups ready to step in. In fact, over 90% of cleaning requests get picked up, and more than half of them are claimed within just 50 minutes of booking. That kind of speed and dependability is something you won't find with traditional cleaning companies.

tabs.label: Discovery Questions
tabs.title: Discovery Questions
tabs.html:
Five levels, from basic need to readiness. Use one or two per level, then go to the Elevator Pitch.

Level 1: Uncovering basic need for cleaning service

S1: What prompted you to look for a cleaning service?

S2: What made you decide to look for a cleaning service?

S3: How long have you been considering getting a cleaner for your home?

Level 2: Encourage customers to share why they need the service

S1: You mentioned you haven't had your home cleaned in a while, how is this affecting your day-to-day?

S2: You mentioned you are unable to clean your home because of (cite the pain point), how long has it been a problem for you?

Level 3: Uncovering customer expectations

S1: What are your expectations when looking for a cleaning service?

S2: What part of a cleaning service do you think you'll be most happy with?

Level 4: Anticipating roadblocks

S1: What's the biggest factor for you in deciding whether our cleaning service is a good fit for you?

S2: What factors are most important to you when considering a regular cleaning service like ours?

S3: What's the key factor for you in determining if our cleaning service suits your needs?

S4: What factors are most important to you when choosing a regular cleaning service like ours?

Level 5: Checking for readiness

S1: Would you be happy to proceed if we can meet all your requirements for a cleaning service?

S2: Are you open to moving forward if we satisfy all your requirements?

S3: Assuming we check all the boxes for you, would you be happy to move forward?

S4: Would you be ready to proceed if we can satisfy all that you're looking for in a cleaning service?

tabs.label: FAQs
tabs.title: FAQs
tabs.html:
Which states have applicable taxes?

AR Arkansas, CT Connecticut, DC District of Columbia, HI Hawaii, KY Kentucky, MN Minnesota, NE Nebraska, NJ New Jersey, NM New Mexico, NY New York, OH Ohio, PA Pennsylvania, SD South Dakota, TX Texas, UT Utah, WV West Virginia. For these customers, use the "+ Applicable Taxes" pitch tiles.

Are your cleaners bonded and insured?

S1: Every Cleaning Professional on Homeaglow has passed through extensive certification and strict criminal background check. And while we do not provide insurance, many of the Cleaning Professionals joined Homeaglow having operated their own cleaning businesses and many choose to carry their own bonding and insurance.

S2: You would be delighted to know that while the Cleaning professionals who get onboard the Homeaglow platform are independent contractors, they all go through extensive certification and strict criminal background checking. This gives you the peace of mind knowing that the person you let in your home is someone who has gone through strict screening.

Can I book an appointment for tomorrow?

Normally we recommend a 2-day window to allow the CPs to take the appointment. (Try to confirm if the customer will book 2 days from today.)

If no: We will do our best to schedule your cleaning for tomorrow. However, please keep in mind that we can't guarantee a cleaner will be available on short notice. To ensure we can accommodate you, it might be helpful to provide an alternate date that works for you.

How can I get the same cleaner for all of my upcoming appointments?

I get you! It just makes things a whole lot easier if it's the same person every time. And you would be happy to know that you have the option to book the same Cleaning Professional for all your appointments simply by logging in to your dashboard.

However, please keep in mind that this is still subject to the cleaner's availability, as they may have other commitments. We recommend booking in advance to increase the chances of securing your preferred cleaner. If you have any questions or need assistance with the booking process, feel free to reach out!

My bank flagged the company as a scam and won't approve the transaction

(Ask for another card first.) Thank you for bringing this to our attention. I'm sorry to hear that your bank flagged our transaction. We understand that this can be frustrating, and I want to assure you that I'm here to work with you until this gets resolved. If you're comfortable, you might consider using a different payment card for this transaction. This could help resolve the issue quickly and ensure we can complete booking your first appointment with us.

(If no other card, offer to stay on while they call the bank.) I'm sorry to hear that your bank flagged our transaction. Sometimes banks use strict security measures to protect their customers, and this can lead to misunderstandings. If possible, I can stay with you on the line if you want to contact your bank to clarify the situation. They may be able to adjust their settings to allow transactions with us to go through.

What cleaning tools or supplies will my cleaner bring?

S1: You don't need to provide anything. Cleaners generally bring their own equipment and supplies. If you'd like your cleaner to use your own products, that's possible too. Just let them know prior to your appointment.

S2: You are not required to supply anything. Typically, cleaners bring their own cleaning tools and supplies. It's also an option if you want your cleaner to use your own supplies, or if there is a particular cleaning product you prefer them to use during the cleaning. Simply inform them before your scheduled visit.

What happens if my cleaner is late or doesn't show up? Who do I contact?

S1: I can understand why that would be a concern. All the Cleaning Professionals are thoroughly vetted and have gone through extensive screening. You would be happy to know that in the rare event that they arrive late or fail to show up to your appointment, we have a 24/7 Customer Support Team to help you. Just let us know and we'll be glad to rectify it for you.

S2: I hear you. It would really be concerning if they arrive late or fail to show up to your appointment. The beauty of booking with Homeaglow is that you get direct contact with your assigned Cleaning Professional once they claim your request. You will see their information on your dashboard, including their phone number, in case you'd like to contact them before the cleaning. Alternatively, the cleaner may also contact you before your scheduled cleaning date.

What if I'm not happy with my first cleaning? Will I get a refund?

S1: That makes perfect sense. Here at Homeaglow, your satisfaction is our top priority. This means that after your cleaning appointment, if you feel that your expectations were not met or something isn't to your liking, please let us know and we have all the checks and balances to help rectify that for you.

S2: Hey, I get you! Most of our long-term customers had the same concerns initially. All of the Cleaning Professionals who get on board the Homeaglow platform have gone through extensive certification and go through regular reviews based on customer feedback and ratings. This means you get only the top-rated professionals to clean your home. Now if after the appointment you feel that your expectations were not met or something isn't to your liking, please let us know and we'll be happy to take care of it for you.

What is included in the cleaning service?

S1: Here at Homeaglow, we want to make sure that no corners are left untouched. A standard cleaning with Homeaglow includes wiping down and sanitizing surfaces, vacuuming and mopping floors, cleaning and sanitizing sinks, showers, and bathtubs, tidying, and removing garbage.

S2: We take care of everything from top to bottom! Vacuuming, mopping, dusting, wiping of surfaces, bathrooms, kitchen sinks, we even take out the trash for you! We want to make sure that everything is sparkly clean, and that no corners are left untouched after the appointment.

Will it be a $23/hr cleaner rate for all my future appointments?

S1: What most of our members love about FC is that their subsequent cleanings cost as low as $23/hour, a savings of up to 50% compared to the local average rate when enrolled in the ForeverClean membership.

S2: The majority of our members love FC because, when enrolled in the ForeverClean membership, their subsequent cleanings are as little as $23/hour, saving them up to 50% over the average charge in the area.

What is the Premium Cleaner Add-On?

It gives the customer the option to have their cleaning completed by a Premium Cleaner for an additional $20 per cleaning, plus applicable taxes. It's charged per cleaning, only when a Premium Cleaner completes it, and it can apply to the first cleaning. Full script is at the end of the Verbatim step.

tabs.label: Process Updates
tabs.title: Process Updates
tabs.html:
Process changes that apply to every call.

NEW · Premium Cleaner Add-On must be offered on every call

Effective immediately, offer the Premium Cleaner Add-On on every sales call, after the sale is confirmed and right after you resume the recording. The script is the last section of the Verbatim step, right after the recap. Offered and accepted: +0.2 QA. Not offered: −0.2 QA.

This replaces the earlier "Premium Upsell" update that said agents were not required to offer it.

NEW · Temporary card hold disclosure

Before the card is charged, read the temporary card hold disclosure (a hold of up to $75, not a charge) word for word. The script is in the Booking step.

HubSpot notes

To prevent penalties for non-Booking Proper:

  • All agents must leave notes in HubSpot after every interaction.
  • When handling a ticket or lead, read the last three (3) notes first.

DNC requests

If the customer says anything like the lines below, tag the lead CLOSED - DO NOT CALL AGAIN in HubSpot:

  • "Please do not contact me again."
  • "I want to opt-out of future communications."
  • "I am on the Do Not Call list."
  • "Remove me from your mailing or calling list."
  • "I no longer wish to receive updates or promotions."
  • "Do not message/call me anymore."
  • "I have changed my mind; please stop contacting me."
  • "I do not consent to receive marketing messages/calls."
  • "Please respect my privacy and do not reach out."
  • "I want to be taken off your list."
  • "STOP"

Failing to comply is a Level 3 Zero Tolerance violation: 1st instance, Final Warning (NTE); 2nd, 5-day suspension; 3rd, subject to termination.

Inbound calls from existing customers

Step 1, suggested script: Hi (Customer), you've reached the sales department. Unfortunately, we don't have access to customer accounts, so I'm unable to assist with your concern. I'll transfer you to our customer service team, and an agent will help you. If there's a long wait, you can leave a message with your concern and phone number, and a representative will get back to you within 24 to 72 hours.

Step 2: Transfer the call to Aftersales and Acct Mgt in Aircall.

HubSpot: ticket status "Closed as Do not call again", sub-status "Do not call again because this is already an existing customer".

Don't log tickets in the old "CS Concerns from FC Sales" file. Don't promise that a refund or cancellation will be approved, or that someone will help shortly: Aftersales runs a retention process and isn't staffed 24/7.

Manual charges for trials and one-time cleanings

Use the standard reason in the CRM/Agent Facing Descriptor: Trial_Cleaning for trials, One_time_cleaning for one-time cleanings. This keeps engineering's reports accurate. If the charge is an hours adjustment, you still only need to say whether it's a trial or a one-time cleaning.

tabs.label: User Manual
tabs.title: User Manual
tabs.html:
How to use this guide:

  1. Start with Opening Spiel and use the opener for the lead type (APEX or Revisit). Keep the recorded-line disclosure.
  2. Run Discovery: APEX leads go through the five levels in Discovery Questions; Revisit leads get Q1 to Q4.
  3. Give the Elevator Pitch, then confirm home size in Data Gathering.
  4. In Sales Pitch, open the FCF tile for the recommended hours (use the "+ Applicable Taxes" tile in tax states). Fall back to Negotiate or One-Time Only if needed.
  5. Use the floating calculators on the right for FCF quotes, ETF, negotiation, and one-time or trial prices.
  6. Book in Booking and Booking Proper. Read the temporary card hold disclosure before the card is charged, and pause the recording for card details, resuming it after payment.
  7. Read the Verbatim for what the customer bought, word for word.
  8. Right after the verbatim, once you resume the recording, offer the Premium Cleaner add-on. It's the last section of the Verbatim step and is required on every call. Then finish System Notes.
  9. Use Common Objections, Value Statements and FAQs whenever the customer pushes back or asks.

This is a guide, not a script. Use your own words to make the call natural, but keep the meaning. Anything in red must be read word for word.
